# Decompiled reference (version 1.6.9438.38202)

Values checked against the decompiled RimWorld source at [Chillu1/RimWorldDecompiled](https://github.com/Chillu1/rimworlddecompiled), commit `2d50803`. The repository README says the source is for personal use only; the project owner has accepted that for this work (see CLAUDE.md, reference rules).

Each row is tagged `D`. Its file and line are in the source tree, not in this repository. No code, identifier, comment or string from the source is copied here. The project keeps its own logic in original code.

Only citations that a second pass re-opened and confirmed are listed. Rejected citations are left out. Status compares the decompiled value with the Stillmere value: **matches**, **differs**, or **ambiguous** (depends on runtime data or several candidates). Confidence is the extractor's own rating.

Source version 1.6.9438.38202 is not the pinned target 1.6.4850 (see CLAUDE.md). Values may differ between the two builds until the owner decides which one to pin.

Total confirmed citations: 532.
